Metadata.title: MekongPulse — Cambodia River Telemetry & Flood Guard
Metadata.description: Live Mekong, Bassac, and Tonle Sap telemetry, commune flood-risk tiers, and agronomic directives for Cambodia.

Search.errorResolve: Location Resolver: GPS pin could not be resolved. Select your commune from the menu.
Search.errorDenied: Location Resolver: GPS permission was denied. Select your target commune from the menu.
Search.noMatch: No commune matched. Try a Khmer name (កោះធំ), an English variant (Koh Thom), or a 6-digit code.

Footer.data: Data: MRC telemetry (api.mrcmekong.org) · Open-Meteo rainfall · MEF 2025 commune gazetteer. Risk tiers refresh every 15 minutes; alerts dispatch via the MekongPulse Telegram bot. Bilingual bulletins are synthesized with Gemini Khmer TTS and attached to Sentinel alerts.
